name: Pebble Pals
goal: Control the most garden spaces on the board.
howToWin: Place pebbles, fence in empty spaces and surround enemy pebbles. The player or team with the most points wins.
ruleVariant: Go-inspired: 1 point per pebble, 1 per enclosed or splash space, 2 per captured pebble. Boards 5x5, 7x7 and 9x9. Two passes in a row end the game.
about: Pebble Pals is a kid-friendly game inspired by Go, the ancient board game of territory.
